apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

Not programming that. PT's overhead press ban stands regardless of how your shoulder feels day-to-day — tendinopathy pain often lags the tissue damage, and "feels fine" pre-load isn't the same as cleared. That call belongs to the clinician who set the restriction, not to either of us.

Wednesday's Upper Body Strength stays overhead-free. If you want, I can add rows/pulldowns/face-pulls volume instead — say the word.
